methodology: One uninstrumented CPU run and one five-second Metal trace per scale, 100 then 500 nodes. Fixed source and executable; no concurrent Cargo work during captures. Explicit --always-on-top activates only the temporary profiling window, which closes automatically. CPU runs collect 120 observations after 30 warmup frames. GPU runs use those counts plus a 20-second minimum lifetime, and attach only to the owned PID after 3 seconds. The app remains alive through the trace time-limit marker; both app and profiler complete under the independent 45-second watchdog. The trace-relative [1s,4s] analysis window is selected before inspection, not chosen by timings. Reported percentiles are nearest-rank observations, not confidence intervals or before/after speedups.
fixture: Unmodified paired-builtins-fanout-v1: 100 nodes/500 connections and 500 nodes/2000 connections. Native window 1440x900 logical points at 2 pixels/point, default split panels and 100% graph zoom, most nodes offscreen. No capture sources or execution; viewer output selections disabled. This is distinct from the neutral low-zoom CPU widget fixture.
visual_check: Post-measurement screenshots are inspected at both scales. They show 100/500 node counts, 100% zoom, empty capture/viewer, disabled Run/Start controls, visible shared-output fan-out and the default application panels, without migration/error toasts. The large-scale visible routes are more angular. CPU and trace screenshots have identical hashes at each scale. No route fallback/quality count is inferred from appearance or exposed by this app harness.
raw_retention: Complete uninstrumented CPU and instrumented completion reports; all process-filtered, matched, in-window command-buffer intervals and distributions; excluded-row/buffer counts; XML and screenshot hashes. Raw .trace/XML include incidental system metadata and remain outside the repository in the task temporary directory. Screenshots remain there as well. No unrelated process records are retained.
limitations: GPU span is first stage start to last stage end per command buffer, including gaps. Active union merges channel overlaps, excluding gaps; it is not sum-of-stage time. PendingWrites GPU execution is not total CPU upload/staging cost. CPU and GPU distributions have different windows and are not added or subtracted. No GPU frame-to-presentation correlation, presentation latency, active graph runtime, browser GPU, full-visible-graph, low-zoom application, release/drag, routing quality or 60 Hz whole-graph acceptance claim. A foreground window is necessary on this host but not a general guarantee against locked desktops or higher-level system UI.
